formulas.rule: Drex keeps every question with recorded confidence >= threshold. The rest take DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on DeepInfra, the recorded answer to the same question.
formulas.cost_per_1000_usd: mean of [Drex recorded cost_usd + routed DeepInfra cost]. Routed cost scales the recorded packed call: full input plus output * routed/asked, in list-price weights, multiplied by recorded estimated_cost/list when estimated_cost is present. List rates are the published DeepInfra cents_per_token figures, not the GPT $2/$10 rate.
formulas.latency_p50_ms: median of [Drex recorded latency_ms + DeepInfra recorded latency_ms * routed/asked].

deepinfra_only.label: simulated from recorded answers
deepinfra_only.note: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash recorded answers on every question. Cost is the recorded provider cost. No Drex cost.

gpt_only.label: simulated from recorded answers
gpt_only.note: GPT-6.1 Sol recorded answers on every question. Cost is GPT list price from recorded tokens. No Drex cost.

drex_only.label: simulated from recorded answers
drex_only.note: drex-max-v1.1 recorded answers on every question. Cost is Drex recorded cost_usd.
